name: Slack
description: Trigger workflows from Slack messages, thread replies and channel members, and post, reply or react from a step.

triggers.label: A message is posted in a channel
triggers.description: Fires for each new message in the configured channel. Bot and system messages are skipped unless includeBots is true.

env.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-…) of a Slack app installed to the workspace, from api.slack.com/apps under OAuth & Permissions.
env.builderHint: Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Bot scopes: channels:read, groups:read, channels:history, groups:history, chat:write, reactions:write, users:read, users:read.email. Never put it in the query string; Slack refuses it there.

env.name: SLACK_CHANNEL
env.description: Channel id such as C0123456789 the triggers watch. The bot must be a member.
env.builderHint: An id (C… or G…), not a name. Reading history or members of a channel the bot is not in answers not_in_channel.

env.name: SLACK_THREAD_TS
env.description: The parent message ts, such as 1512085950.000216, for the reply trigger.
env.builderHint: Only the reply trigger reads it. A ts is a string; do not round it.

env.name: SLACK_INCLUDE_BOTS
env.description: true delivers messages with a subtype or a bot_id too; joins, topic changes, app posts.
env.builderHint: Applies to the channel trigger only; thread replies are delivered whoever wrote them.

env.name: SLACK_LIMIT
env.builderHint: Some non-Marketplace apps get conversations.history at 1 request a minute with limit capped at 15; keep polls minutes apart.

actions.label: Post a message
actions.description: Post a message to a channel, optionally under a thread or with Block Kit blocks.

inputs.label: Channel
inputs.description: Channel id, or a name the bot can resolve
inputs.builderHint: An id, not a name: names are not unique and Slack renames them. The bot must be a member.

inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: Message text; with blocks it is the notification fallback

inputs.label: Thread
inputs.description: Parent message ts to reply under
inputs.builderHint: Leave empty to post at the top level.

inputs.label: Blocks
inputs.description: Block Kit layout as a JSON array
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the blocks array; Slack answers invalid_blocks when it is malformed.

outputs.description: The channel id it landed in

actions.label: Reply in a thread
actions.description: Post a reply under a parent message.

inputs.label: Channel
inputs.builderHint: An id, not a name: names are not unique and Slack renames them. The bot must be a member.

actions.label: Add a reaction
actions.description: React to a message with an emoji.

inputs.label: Channel
inputs.builderHint: An id, not a name: names are not unique and Slack renames them. The bot must be a member.

inputs.label: Emoji
inputs.description: Emoji name without colons, e.g. thumbsup
inputs.builderHint: Slack answers invalid_name for a name it does not know.

outputs.description: true once the reaction is on

actions.label: List channels
actions.description: List the public and private channels the bot can see, unarchived only.

inputs.label: Cursor
inputs.description: nextCursor from an earlier call, for the next page

outputs.description: Array of { id, name, isPrivate, isArchived, topic, purpose, numMembers }

inputs.label: Channel
inputs.builderHint: An id, not a name: names are not unique and Slack renames them. The bot must be a member.

actions.label: Find a user by email
actions.description: Look a user up by the address registered on the workspace.

inputs.label: Email
inputs.description: The address registered on the workspace
inputs.builderHint: Needs users:read.email; an unknown or deactivated address answers users_not_found.
